title: Any APPLICABLE one of the six M&A validators missing at DD exit
notes: Scope is APPLICABLE validators (ADR-0048): all six are declared for every project; a validator the applicability registry does not apply is covered-with-reason via a live not_applicable compliance_check row and is NOT missing. The 3-number record (6 declared / N applicable / M completed) is computed by db/lib/validator-completeness.ts (migration 0016). Still declared in YAML, not yet executable — predicate null by design until thresholds are set (design Decision 8). No waiver path: completeness check, not judgment (design section 8.9-1(f)). Classification (ADR-0060): class (iii) — no snapshot var; proposed: validators.applicable_missing (count, computed by the validator-completeness engine in db/lib/validator-completeness.ts, which exposes no snapshot var today; threshold >=1 decided by the criterion wording).
